headline: Adopted revised policies on bullying investigations and electronic communication between employees and students.
summary: The board heard an update on the FY28 budget, with a preliminary budget due December 2 and the first Budget Blitz round set for November 16-20. The Chittenden Central Cooperative Educational Service Area voted to cancel its November and December meetings. Discussion also covered public comment rules and the Act 170 merger committee.
decisions: Adopted Policy F4, Investigation and Response to Harassment, Hazing, and Bullying of Students, on third reading by unanimous vote.
Adopted Policy D9, Electronic Communications Between Employees and Students, on third reading by unanimous vote.
Approved a motion to monitor Monitoring Report 2.7 Asset Protection, with all in favor.
Approved a motion to monitor Monitoring Report 2.8 Compensation and Benefits, with all in favor.
Approved the consent agenda, including the October 21, 2026 board meeting minutes and one resignation or retirement, with all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Emilee Hoffman made a motion and Elissa Galvez seconded the motion to adopt the policy. Hearing no further discussion, all were in favor and the motion passed by unanimous vote.
Emilee Hoffman made a motion and Dan Boyer seconded the motion to adopt the policy. Hearing no further discussion, all were in favor and the motion passed by unanimous vote.

The Board was asked to consider a motion to monitor 2.7 Asset Protection, using the monitoring rubric included in the Board materials. Emilee Hoffman moved and Elissa Galvez seconded the motion. All were in favor and the motion passed.

The Board was asked to consider a motion to monitor 2.8 Compensation and Benefits, using the monitoring rubric included in the Board materials. Emilee Hoffman moved and Dan Boyer seconded the motion. All were in favor and the motion passed.
Thomas Chittenden moved to accept and Michelle Boyer seconded the motion. All were in favor; consent agenda was passed and items were approved.
